items.title: Implement the confidence route and build artifact
items.description: Implement the build-time confidence route so the calendar artifact makes one deterministic Merge/Group/Separate decision for every event listing. The route operates on cleaned events, never deletes a row because of similarity, and emits versioned duplicate-group IDs and diagnostics downstream consumers can trust. Done when: exact-title Merge uses the full cleaned title, compatible non-empty locations, deterministic survivor selection, and no similarity-edge propagation; Group uses same-instant connected components, the agreed guards and threshold, versioned IDs, bounded comparisons, and structured source aggregation; Separate stays authoritative and NULL group membership means one row is one group downstream; missing source_uid and route invariants fail closed with actionable diagnostics; the pure-route, ICS-boundary, false-merge, chain, truncation, instant, all-day, location, source-name, determinism, and blast-radius tests pass; and the generated event artifact contains the route output and per-event outcomes needed by later tickets. See the issue for the full acceptance criteria.
items.notes: Added the pure confidence_route() to scripts/ics_to_json.py (ROUTE_VERSION=cr1, threshold 0.80, guards ON) plus clean_title/normalize_route_title, split location predicates (both-present for Merge, or-empty for Group), variant/all-day guards, structured_source_names, deterministic survivor (primary-first, smallest uid, smallest url), versioned group ids, and validate_route_result() failing closed on missing source_uid, deletion without an exact-title survivor, duplicate survivors, malformed groups, and component/comparison budgets (25 / 250k). ics_to_json now runs the route on cleaned events, writes duplicate_group into events.json, and writes an events.route.json sidecar with per-event outcomes; cluster_id is left as a None passthrough and combine_ics title dedup is untouched (later items). similarity_test.py now imports the one canonical token-set function. 37 new tests in tests/test_confidence_route.py cover the pure route, ICS boundary (encoded-title merge), guards, chain/truncation/instant/all-day/location/source-name, determinism, and a real 1,029-listing blast-radius fixture. Full Python suite 290 pass, node 220 pass, pnpm bench pass, ruff and all four type checkers clean. Decisions: differing US state tokens make locations explicitly incompatible; deleted merge members carry duplicate_group=None with survivor_uid for tracing.

items.title: Persist duplicate groups and expose the authoritative view
items.description: Persist the route's duplicate-group decision and expose it through the authoritative deduplicated read model. Done when: the database stores nullable duplicate_group and stores the route output; the materialized view groups by stored group ID and isolates every NULL row instead of collapsing NULLs together; grouped rows aggregate member IDs, structured source URLs, source names, and representative fields deterministically; the event loader persists the field without breaking existing upsert and stale-event behavior; migration, grants, indexes, refresh behavior, and database tests are complete; and materialized-view refresh failures fail the pipeline.
items.notes: Landed persistence + the authoritative view. Migration supabase/migrations/20260922120000_add_duplicate_group_and_route_view.sql adds nullable events.duplicate_group plus source_names text[] and duplicate_group_representative text, and recreates deduplicated_events to group by (city, start_time, coalesce(duplicate_group, 'row:'||id)) so every NULL row is its own group; the view unions merged_ids, source_urls (jsonb), and structured source names, and presents the route's representative id/fields instead of min(id). The route now persists source_names (ordered, primaries first) and duplicate_group_representative (min by aggregator-priority, source_uid, url); validate_route_result fails closed on a group without exactly one member representative or a Separate row declaring one. Also fixed structured_source_names so a lone human source name is not overridden by a divergent ICS-assembly url-map key (slug fallback); comma-joined strings still defer to the url map. Loader needs no change: load-events upserts whole event objects, so the new columns persist automatically and delete_stale_events is untouched (its pgTAP suite still passes). The refresh-failure criterion was already met by the existing non-continue-on-error 'Refresh deduplicated events' workflow step. Tests: 7 new Python route tests plus supabase/tests/test_deduplicated_events.sql (22 pgTAP assertions); 298 pytest, 220 vitest, 41 pgTAP, ruff + 4 type checkers, prettier/eslint, pnpm bench, and validate_pr_feeds all green on a fresh supabase db reset. Decisions (unattended, pre-approved): added the two extra columns beyond the spec's earlier 'only duplicate_group' schema line because the 2026-09-22 review amendment requires structured source names and the route's representative rather than min(id). Observation for review: 15/1027 fixture rows whose human source name itself contains a comma fall back to the slug url-map key (e.g. 'Events Livewhale 11'); root cause is combine_ics get_source_name's slug fallback feeding X-SOURCE-URLS, not the view; candidate follow-up.

items.title: Switch calendar, dashboard, and picks to stored groups
items.description: Switch the main calendar, dashboard tiles, and saved-picks experience to the stored deduplicated read model so each Group renders once while every member source and pick remains available. Done when: all relevant REST projections include duplicate_group and merged_ids; the main calendar and dashboard consume the authoritative deduplicated view rather than raw-event fallback logic; NULL groups remain separate in the client; grouped cards retain deterministic representative presentation and every member source link; picking or unpicking a Group covers all IDs in merged_ids; My Picks and the Pick Editor show no duplicate representations of one Group; and client, browser, and database seam tests pass.
items.notes: Switched the client consumers to the stored route decision. helpers.dedupeEvents now keys on (start_time, duplicate_group): a non-NULL group collapses, a NULL group is one row is one group keyed by row id (the title+time fallback is gone), membership is seeded from the view's merged_ids, source_urls are unioned, and the sort uses duplicate_group instead of cluster_id. clusterBorder now hashes the opaque duplicate_group id (pinned colour test) and returns none for NULL/filtered. New helpers.eventMergedIds (camelCase mergedIds -> view merged_ids -> [id]) feeds EventCard pick state and Globals.togglePick, which now clears every pick in the group on unpick; new helpers.dedupePicks collapses My Picks to one row per stored group (canonical representative preferred, identity-cached) for both the list and its count. shell.js's deduplicated_events projection gained duplicate_group (merged_ids was already selected); FeedTile switched from the raw events table to deduplicated_events with duplicate_group/merged_ids/source_urls, so dashboard tiles and the main list read the same view. The my-picks ICS feed was treated as part of the saved-picks experience: its projection gained source_uid/duplicate_group/duplicate_group_representative and it collapses picked members to one entry per stored group via new dedupe.ts. Tests: 19 vitest in tests/js/validate-dedupe-groups.test.js (group collapse, NULL separate, different stored groups stay separate, mergedIds seeding, clusterBorder pin, eventMergedIds, dedupePicks representative preference, plus source-contract assertions for the shell/FeedTile/EventCard/Main projections); the shipped xmlui/test.html harness's old title-fallback dedupe tests were rewritten to the stored-group + NULL-separate contract; 3 Deno tests in supabase/functions/my-picks/dedupe_test.ts. Verified: 298 pytest, 239 vitest, 25 Playwright, 41 pgTAP (supabase test db), ruff + 4 type checkers, prettier/eslint, pnpm bench, and deno check all green. Decisions (unattended, pre-approved): dedupe the my-picks feed too and extract dedupe.ts so the test imports without booting Deno.serve; keep cluster_id readable in the view (compatibility window, removed in a later item). Observation for review: the Deno edge-function test runs locally (deno test supabase/functions/my-picks/dedupe_test.ts) but is not wired into make test or CI because the repo has no Deno harness; candidate follow-up for #155 or the review.

items.title: Make RSS consume stored group decisions
items.description: Make RSS consume the stored route decisions so each Group renders once, uses the same canonical representative as the app, and does not repeatedly announce suppressed members as new. Done when: RSS does not recompute similarity, location, or grouping; full and latest feeds render one item per stored Group; new-item state considers all current member UIDs, including members suppressed from rendering; repeated builds with unchanged membership produce no false new-item announcements; and RSS uses the route's canonical representative with tests covering representative and membership changes.
items.notes: generate_rss.py is now a pure consumer of the stored route decision. New group_key keys a non-NULL duplicate_group as one Group and a NULL group as one row is one group (per-row key, so Separate rows never collapse). group_upcoming collapses each Group to one feed entry whose representative is the route's duplicate_group_representative (a Separate row is its own; a missing declared representative falls back to smallest GUID), and each entry carries every member GUID. Both feeds render one item per Group. Suppressed members are emitted as <category> UIDs on the item, and read_feed_state now returns the union of item GUIDs and category UIDs as known_uids, so the next build's new-item test (members <= prev_full_known) sees all current member UIDs including suppressed ones: an unchanged membership carries its first-seen pubDate and never re-announces, while a newly joining member stamps now and is announced even when the representative GUID is already known. main() delegates to a testable generate(city, events, outdir, state_dir, now) with injected clock/state. No similarity, location, or grouping logic is recomputed. New tests/test_generate_rss.py (6 tests) drive two consecutive builds through the written XML: one item per stored Group, NULL rows separate, stored-decision-not-similarity, unchanged-membership no re-announce, new-member announced, representative change not re-announced. Verified: 304 pytest, 239 vitest, 25 Playwright, 41 pgTAP, pnpm bench, validate_pr_feeds, ruff + all four type checkers clean. Decision (unattended, pre-approved): member UIDs ride on standard RSS <category> elements because the state model keeps no storage beyond the feeds themselves; this is the minimal self-contained way for a later build to know about suppressed members.

items.title: Complete compatibility transition and integration verification
items.description: Complete the compatibility transition so duplicate_group is the only active grouping authority, legacy cluster_id has a bounded compatibility window, and the full repository passes the integrated route, database, frontend, RSS, and performance checks. Done when: all active consumers use duplicate_group; cluster_id remains only for the explicitly allowed compatibility build and has no competing producer; performance, pipeline, frontend, database, RSS, and full-artifact checks pass together; a separately verified cleanup migration removes unused cluster_id behavior after no consumer remains; and the domain glossary and ADR documentation record the final Merge/Group/Separate model.

items.title: Review the work against the spec
items.description: Run the `code-review` skill over `git diff b188ccd379923e2286e152c0dfdbc8ce98cc22cf...HEAD` (the diff since this scope was seeded) against the spec at `.scratch/150-dedup-confidence-route/spec-150.md`, reviewing the implementation of #150 and its sub-tickets. Run the findings through `receiving-code-review`, then append each worthwhile finding as a new item with no `reference`, `hand_off: false`, and a `priority` greater than this item's. Write every remaining finding and every outstanding hand-off item into this item's `notes`. The HITL item (#156) is placed after this review by design, not by oversight: a person approves the production build only once the review findings are resolved, so this review is the last gating item before the hand-off.

items.title: HITL: Deploy, observe, and approve the first production build
items.description: Human-verify the production migration and first scheduled build before destructive Merge behavior is considered live. Done when: the Supabase migration, materialized-view contract, grants, and refresh permissions are verified in production; one production build completes with route diagnostics and expected refresh behavior; Merge/group counts, maximum group size, and invariant diagnostics are reviewed against the agreed safety budget; the main calendar, dashboard, saved picks, source links, and RSS are spot-checked for parity; and a human approves the observed blast radius or records required follow-up changes. This item follows the review by design: a person approves the production build only after the review findings are resolved.
